description:
Advances: ancora.tasks

Stage: L10 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
mix spec.prime (--base, --since, --root, --spec-dir; no --json), mix spec.next (--base, --since, --verbose; classification and reconciliation labels carried verbatim from specled_ex), mix spec.status (--root, --spec-dir; exit 0 always; derived-set report derived subjects=<N> empty=<E> thin(<3)=<T> plus per-subject rows with generated=<project>+<dep> split and an acknowledged label for subjects carrying an override; thin=3 documented constant, non-configurable). No verdict lines on any of the three; error paths through gated (bad base = env-style message, exit 1). prime --base HEAD prints the loop ending with the check command and read_protocol/0.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged_tests covering ancora.tasks.report_task_flags, next_labels_verbatim, status_derived_report, prime_loop
- Behaviors to demonstrate: ancora.tasks.scenario.json_rejected_on_reports, status_always_zero, status_splits_generated, next_labels, prime_footer; states per task: normal report, empty corpus, env failure
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or named files plus mix spec.check --base HEAD; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands run-until-green before IMPLEMENTED
  - Verifier tier: tagged tests for the ids above plus --stale only
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: agent sessions run spec.prime at session start and spec.next after changes; proving tests are the task output tests
  - Fixture hygiene: reuse L9 fixture projects; nothing compiled
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered (each state per task; label branches)
- Call-site Integration: production caller is the agent loop (AGENTS.md teaches prime --base HEAD and next); proving tests are the output tests for each state.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/gate*, lib/ancora/derive/**, lib/ancora/output* (read-only here)
- lib/ancora/review*, lib/mix/tasks/spec.{review,init,decision.new}.ex
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/prime.ex, lib/ancora/next.ex, lib/ancora/status.ex
- lib/mix/tasks/spec.prime.ex, lib/mix/tasks/spec.next.ex, lib/mix/tasks/spec.status.ex
- test/ancora/{prime,next,status}_test.exs, test/mix/tasks/spec_{prime,next,status}_test.exs, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.tasks.spec.md (acknowledging edits to requirement/scenario blocks only; never weakening)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no verdict line on any report task; no --json anywhere but spec.check
- no change to spec.next label strings (they are a de facto API)
- no strength summaries, no --bugfix, no --run-commands, no --min-strength

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.check --base HEAD emits a verdict line
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
